tier_meaning.gold: three or more independent lineages agreed
tier_meaning.reference: PROJ-generated regression baseline; expected coordinates recomputed locally with PROJ, not copied from upstream PROJ internal tests

note: gold and silver expected values are a consensus across independent lineages; reference values come from PROJ alone and do not establish correctness; compare with tolerance_m, never for equality

field_meaning.coordinate_epoch: the epoch to supply with the source coordinates; required to reproduce any record that carries it
field_meaning.source_frame_epoch: reference epoch of the source dynamic frame, descriptive only; using it as the coordinate epoch moves the answer by up to a metre
field_meaning.proj_expectation: pass: PROJ agreed or supplied a reference baseline; xfail: PROJ was unsuccessful during generation, retained to detect future support.
field_meaning.expected_value_source: proj_generated_regression_baseline: EPSG-derived input case, expected values computed by the installed PROJ through pyproj; no upstream PROJ test-file provenance is asserted

horizontal_conversion.jsonl.description: Same datum; projection and unit maths only.

horizontal_datum_shift.jsonl.description: Datum change by analytic method (Helmert, Molodensky-Badekas).

horizontal_grid.jsonl.description: Datum change that consumed a PROJ grid file. Requires those grids.

dynamic.jsonl.description: Epoch-dependent; source or target is a dynamic reference frame.

export_policy.description: Keep consensus values reproduced by PROJ within tolerance (including equivalent wrapped longitudes) and explicit PROJ expected failures; exclude successful numerical dissent and absent PROJ evidence.
